title: How Far Back a Settlement Reaches on a Medicare Supplement Premium Account
content:
A settlement of a premium account under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies reaches back over a span of the account, and every charge posted within that span is owed. The span is fixed as follows.

1. Where the policy has been in force more than 12 months and a payment that settled a billing period in full stands within the 12 months to date, the settlement reaches back over the 12 months to date.
2. Where the policy has been in force 12 months or less and a payment that settled a billing period in full stands within the 12 months to date, the settlement reaches back to the day the policy took effect.
3. Where neither of those holds, the settlement reaches back over the billing period now current alone.

| Months the policy has been in force | A payment settling a billing period in full within the 12 months to date | The span reached back over |
|---|---|---|
| More than 12 | Yes | The 12 months to date |
| 12 or less | Yes | Back to the day the policy took effect |
| Any | No | The billing period now current alone |

### The boundary between the first two

The two rows that require such a payment divide at 12 months in force. A policy in force for exactly 12 months falls in the second row and reaches back to the day it took effect; a policy in force for 13 months falls in the first and reaches back over the 12 months to date.

Where no payment within the 12 months to date settled a billing period in full, neither of those rows is reached, however long the policy has been in force, and the settlement reaches back over the billing period now current alone.

### Hypothetical spans

A policy in force 26 months with one payment in the last 12 months that settled a billing period in full: the settlement reaches back over the 12 months to date, and every charge posted within those 12 months is owed.

A policy in force 5 months with such a payment: the settlement reaches back to the day the policy took effect, and every charge posted since is owed.

A policy in force 26 months with no such payment in the 12 months to date, billed quarterly: the settlement reaches back over the billing period now current alone, being the 3 months that cadence bills at a time.
